NDC-2814.text: Fixed, live on tavi 8 Nov. Moving to Ready For Test. A rule condition "Execution Time on a holiday of <list>" now reads the list's own holidays whether or not the list is linked to business hours (desk #238). A list that isn't linked still doesn't close any business hours for SLAs. The date is read in the default business hours' time zone. Checked live on NDC Staging: I created a holiday list with business hours off and today as a holiday, plus a temporary direct rule "on a holiday of" that list. A new ticket matched and went to the rule's agent. The list, the rule and the probe ticket were deleted.

NDC-2813.text: Fixed, live on tavi 8 Nov. Moving to Ready For Test. Cause: the New Ticket form leaves out its untouched Ticket Owner on purpose, so direct assignment rules can still decide, and the server then gave the ticket to its creator. The NDC-2275 fix of 6 Nov removed that fallback, so the ticket was saved Unassigned. This was a regression from that fix. Now (metadata-engine #213): Ticket Owner left as the signed-in agent: the ticket is theirs. A matching direct rule can still assign it to someone else. Ticket Owner cleared: the ticket stays unassigned, so round robin assigns it (the NDC-2275 retest case). An API create that declares itself (source "api" or "web_form") and names no owner: unassigned, so the rules route it. Checked live on NDC Staging in QA AS6 Dept B: an untouched owner went to the creator, a cleared owner stayed unassigned, and an API create with no owner stayed unassigned. The probe tickets were deleted.

NDC-2812.text: The follow-ups from my last comment are fixed and live on tavi (8 Nov). The ticket stays in Ready For Test. With a department's Team Assignment off, these also refuse a team now (desk #239): Reassigning a departing agent's work: choosing a team for that department is refused with "Team Assignment is off in that department … Choose an agent." Choosing an agent still works. Deleting a team and moving its tickets to another team: the move is refused if any of its open tickets is in such a department, and nothing moves. An SLA escalation that reassigns to a team: the reassign is skipped and the ticket keeps its owner. Ticket history shows "Team Assignment is off in the department". The SLA's notifications and priority change still run. Every way to give a ticket to a team now checks the setting: assign, move, both bulk reassigns, rules and SLA escalations. Checked live on NDC Staging in QA AS6 Dept A with team QA AS6 Team A: With Team Assignment off, the agent reassign and the team-delete move to that team were refused, and the probe ticket stayed with its team. With it on, both were accepted. The probe team and ticket were deleted and the setting restored. The SLA escalation case was checked by automated tests only, not by a live SLA breach. Known gap: the two reassign dialogs still list teams, so the admin sees the message only after choosing one.

NDC-2811.text: Fixed, live on tavi 8 Nov. Moving to Ready For Test. Cause: round robin already checks the agent's status for the ticket's channel (chat tickets need Chat on, phone tickets Phone, email and web form tickets Email). The test tickets had no channel (New Ticket form or API), and a ticket with no channel only required the agent to be signed in. Now (desk #237), a ticket with no channel needs Email on, like Zoho's "Tickets" status. An agent with Email off is skipped and listed as SKIPPED. With Email off for the whole pool, the ticket waits unassigned, unless the department allows offline agents. Checked live on NDC Staging in QA AS6 Dept A with a temporary round robin rule (deleted afterwards). With my Email off, a new ticket was not given to me. With Email on, it was. My status was restored and the probe tickets deleted.

NDC-2754.text: The last open case from the 7 Nov retest is fixed and live on staging-desk. Owning a step is now enough to complete its Share, as the QA lead decided. A step owner without the share permission (desk:ticket:share) can run a step that requires a Share. The form shows the share rows instead of asking for access from an admin, and the run adds the share. This also covers an owner from another department that the ticket is shared with at Full access. The Share action on the ticket itself is unchanged and still needs the share permission. desk #235, client-engine #794. Please retest your failing steps. Use a blueprint with dynamic owners and a transition with a required Share. On an admin-owned ticket, assign that transition to Desk Agent fedelav803. As the agent, open the ticket and run the transition with a share to another department. Expected: 200, and the department now shares the ticket. Item 10 still needs Happiness Rating turned on for the tenant.
